Video Editor · Beta

Video Editor

A video editor that never uploads your footage.

Open now

Nothing to install: just open it in the browser on your phone, tablet or computer. It keeps working without internet after your first visit. Want an icon on your home screen? On iPhone or iPad, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen. On Android, open the browser menu and tap Add to Home screen. On a computer, click the install icon in the address bar.

Video Editor has these main features: Multi-track timeline; Trim, split, transitions & titles. It opens Video, Audio, Any image.

Beta: still being tested, so some parts may change.

What you can do with Video Editor

  • Merge videos into one
  • Trim or cut a video
  • Make a GIF from a video
  • Add text to a video
  • Make a split screen video
  • A free CapCut alternative that never uploads your footage
